newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Carrier to buy 26 pct of Tadiran Electric.
newsitem.headline: Carrier to buy 26 pct of Tadiran Electric.

text.p: Carrier Corp, a subsidiary of United Technologies, will acquire 26 percent of Tadiran Electrical Appliances from Tadiran Ltd, Tadiran Ltd said on Tuesday.

Tadiran said the U.S. company would pay $17.5 million for the holding. In addition, Carrier has an option to acquire another three percent of Tadiran Electric from Tadiran Ltd at a price "close" to the Tel Aviv market price.
For the 26 percent stake, Carrier will be paying roughly a $4.5 million premium on Tadiran Electric's market valuation. A spokeswoman said the option on the three percent had no time limit.
Based on Tadiran Electric's Monday closing price on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, the stake is worth approximately $13 million.

Carrier also took an option to raise its stake in Tadiran Electric to a controlling 51 percent within three years, Tadiran said. It added that the price for the option would be based on Tadiran Electric's profits in the next three years.
The agreement also calls for strategic cooperation between Tadiran Electric, a maker of air conditioners and other consumer appliances, and Carrier, an air conditioner maker.
Tadiran Ltd managing director Israel Zamir said in a statement that the sale was in line with the company's efforts to find multinational strategic partners for its operating units.
Last week, Tadiran Ltd signed a strategic cooperation agreement with Exide Corp, and on February 19 it announced a deal under which IBM Israel is acquiring 51 percent of Tadiran Information Systems.
